title: Meta Ads Audit Run State
description: Per-run orchestration state. Written by scripts/init-audit-run.sh and updated as the sweep progresses, so an interrupted run still shows exactly which of the 30 sections were reached and what they concluded.

lane.description: An audit run never mutates. An execution run is a separate invocation governed by EXECUTION-PROTOCOL.md and never shares a run_id with an audit.

capabilities.description: Per source: which connector-ladder rung supplied it, the real discovered tool names, and the date coverage.

sections.description: Keys 1-30. Each value carries the coverage state and, for DEGRADED/BLOCKED, the missing input and its consequence. This is the machine-readable twin of coverage.md.

gates.description: The two ordering gates. Both record a verdict; neither halts the sweep.
